# Pendo Agent Analytics Setup

Skills that teach agents to work with Pendo Agent Analytics Setup. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [pendo-io/claude-pendo-plugin](https://github.com/pendo-io/claude-pendo-plugin), at commit `340d503`.

Detect AI agents in your codebase and instrument them with Pendo agent analytics via the best-fit path: Python SDK, TypeScript SDK, client-side trackAgent(), or the Conversations API

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Pendo Agent Analytics Setup**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Pendo Agent Analytics Setup**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install setup-agent-analytics@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

1 skills: `setup-agent-analytics`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

The skills mention these environment variables for credentials: `PENDO_API_KEY`. This plugin does not store them.
